summary: Backend-only testing for new ZedPulse Pharmacy Price Watch endpoints. Created /app/backend/tests/test_09_pharmacy.py with 13 pytest cases covering GET /api/pharmacy/items (all/category/search/combined/no-match) and GET /api/pharmacy/stockists. All 13 tests passed (100%). Verified public access without Authorization header, exact item counts (34 total; 15 medication, 14 testing, 5 monitor), shape (id/name/category/subcategory/pack/price_low/price_high/note/available_at), price_low<=price_high positive constraint, unique ids, case-insensitive substring search for 'metformin' returns exactly 2 (metformin-500, metformin-850), 'OMRON' case-insensitive returns Omron monitors, category=testing&q=strips returns strips including glucose + ketone subcategories, nonsense query returns [], category=all equals no filter, and 9 Zambian stockists with name+note.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1166 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold mentioned in guidelines; consider modularizing pharmacy/zedpulse routes & data into separate files.
PHARMACY_ITEMS is a large in-memory constant (~34 items). Fine for MVP, but if prices change frequently this should move to MongoDB or a config file for easier updates without redeploy.
seed_data_creation: None — endpoints are read-only against in-memory constants.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pharmacy Price Watch endpoints verified. 34 items total: 15 medication (metformin x2, glibenclamide, glipizide, insulin x3, amlodipine x2, enalapril, losartan, hctz, atenolol, nifedipine-sr, aspirin), 14 testing (3 glucometers, 3 glucose-strip packs, lancets, lancing device, ketone strips, hba1c, insulin syringes, pen needles, glucose tablets, sharps bin), 5 monitors (omron m2/m3, beurer, microlife, manual sphyg). 9 stockists. Both endpoints are public (no auth). Previous 80 tests (iteration_1..3) not re-run per request.
